Join the Barony of Myrgan Wood at our Summer Champions event to find our next Champions of Arrow and Rapier! There will be many other activities on the schedule that aren’t normally run at events because Myrg likes to keep it weird! 3 Truths and 1 Lie! There will be: 1) Breakable Shields tournament with actual breakable shields! 2) Friday night Team Torchlight Tourney for both Rapier and Armoured! 3) Bardic Bingo! 4) Target Archery Competition with real arrows and live peasants! Adult Event Registration – $25 Adult Member Discount Event Registration – $20 Youth Registration (0-17) – $0 ↗︎ Event Facebook Page Event Schedule Friday 7th Noon Site – opens 7pm-9pm – Open Archery Range 9:00-9:30PM – Armour Inspection for Armored and Rapier 9:30-11:00PM – Combined Discipline Torchlight Tournament Saturday 8th 10am – 11:30am – Opening Court including Invocation and Processional 11:30am – 1pm Rapier – Championship Tourney Begins 1pm – 2:30pm – Breakable Shields Heavy Tourney 1:00pm – 2:30pm – Archery Range opens for warmups, inspections etc. 1:00pm – 2:30pm – A&S Class 2:30pm – 4pm – Archery Championship Tourney 4pm – 5pm – A&S Class 5pm – 7pm – Supper time 7pm – 8pm – Evening Court 8pm – 4am Games in the Eric Roller and stick game Rubber Chicken and Pool Noodle game Jomswinger, Hunker Down etc. ACTIVITY DESCRIPTIONS! 1. Combined Discipline Torchlight Tournament On Friday evening, set up your camp and then join us at the erics in Town Center for a Combined Discipline Torchlight Team Tournament! Enter as a team to fight other teams in a Round Robin Format. Teams may be formed by one of the following 3 methods. 1) One Knight is a team. They fight by themselves as a team of 1 2) Two person team formed by either squires or Current or Past Baronial or Kingdom Armoured Champs 3) Three person teams formed by 3 people who aren’t knighted, squired, or are current or past Baronial or Kingdom Champs. We will be running a fencing tournament concurrently and alternating rounds. Fencing teams can be made up in the same way substituting armoured terminology for fencing terms. There will be a pell in the middle of the eric to be fought around, as an obstacle/teammate 2. Dress the Newbie Competition Get your team together and find a newbie who’s first event was within the last 6 months. Prior to the event, you can talk about a general idea, but you may not do anything. No measuring, no patterning, nothing concrete at all. As soon as morning court finishes, it’s game on. Using materials that you have brought, measure, pattern, cut and sew a complete outfit for them. Set them up with everything that they’d need to play in the SCA. Feast Gear, a cup, jewelry, whatever. Everything must be a gift. Nothing may be lent for the purposes of winning the competition. In evening court, present your newbie to the Crown and show us how well they’re prepared for their new hobby. 3. Myrgan Wood Baronial Fencing Champion Tourney Please join us as either an vying competitor or to test the mettle of those would succeed Vicente as the next Champion of Fencing for Myrgan Wood. Championship is only open to residents of Myrgan Wood and holders of the Blood of the Wood, both subject to the whim of the Their Excellencies, but we welcome the Knowne World to join the tourney and celebrate the Art of Fencing and make our new Champion earn their position. 4. Breakable Shields Heavy Tourney As a fundraiser for the site, we’re running a breakable shields tourney. I’m making a bunch of shields that will break when they get hit. You may buy a shield to enter the tournament. You may buy as many shields as you want. You can re-use shields from round to round if they’re still usable. Strategy will be to find a way to block that doesn’t blow up the shield and to figure out when to sword block vs shield block. Full guantlets will be available to keep your hands safe but please bring your own if you have some too. 5. Populace Choice A&S Competition Following morning Court, competitors are invited to set up their entry in the A&S Pavilion for the populace to view and vote on. The competitors should answer 3 questions: 1) What is it? 2) How does it relate to the SCA time period? 3) How did you make it (how does that differ from how it would have been made in period)? Populace will view the entries and vote on their favorites by putting a marble in the cup in front of their choice. Voting will close 1hr before evening court for tallying. 6. Supper Time There is actually 2 hours on the schedule designated for Supper Time. I know that this is a little weirdand not normally a thing, as we’re accustomed to stuffing food in our faces as we try to rush to get to Court on time. But instead, let’s use this time to make something actually good to eat and to share the time with others that we wish we could see more at events. We have time here to enjoy each other’s company over a good meal so let’s use it with friends. 7. Saturday Night Games Night We have a lot of crowd participation games planned for Saturday night in the erics. We are rolling out a new game where we’re going to tape rubber chickens with squeakers on to 5-6 people’s feet, and then put them in the eric with a blindfolded guy with a pool noodle. Last chicken walker standing wins. We have a log rolling game where you stand on a rolling log, and have a 6’ long stick. Your opponent is outfitted the same and whoever stays on their log the longest wins. You can’t hit the other guy, but you can hit his stick or roller. Will have Jomswinger and Hunker Down and other games as well. We’ll need drums and music to make this really a party so please bring your instruments. Remember, if you can’t be good, then at least be loud. This is the type of Bardic with an audience and polite applause. This is party bardic where the bard is driving the energy level of the party higher

Come see the selection of the new Heirs of Avacal. In the Great barony of Myrgan Wood shall be we lay the contest, Come stay at the inn, enjoy the courtyard and see the clash of blades, and great displays of prowess with sword and spear. Classes will be taught, squires will be struck, and Provost will be fenced. No feast provided, No outside food or drinks allowed in the event Hall . There are many dining options in and around the event site. Curia will be Sunday morning in the Courtyard room E vent Registration: Adults: $30 ( $5 discount with membership ) Youth (12-17): free Children (0-11): free Merchants!! We will have some merchants at Crown who will be plying their trade and showing off their wares We will have: Vikelt Consortium (Anna Penner) Plasticsmith Armoury (Plasticsmith Armoury) Dragon and Thistle (Joan the Just) Yri’s Antlers (Yvonne Gareau) Antonia’s Emporium (Diane Will) Faelan’s Armoury (Faelan’s Armour Page) Be sure to give them a look in the main hall and on the mezzanine all day Saturday! Crown FAQ’s!!! Everything you wanted to know but were afraid to ask! 1 ) Can I bring my banner? Yes! Banners can be hung in the hall using painters tape and blue tac in the hall. Or ziptied to the railing on the mezzanine. No duct tape or command strips please (big fines if we tear a chunk out of the wall, please don’t) 2 ) Is there a feast? No. It was not feasible to have a feast served. 3 ) Can I bring my own food to eat in the halls? As long as it was purchased in the hotel yes. No outside Food or drink is permitted inside the hall or the meeting rooms. If you wish to order food from outside the hotel, please consume it in a hotel room. Yes even snacks. 4 ) I am in need of coffee and tea… From Saturday 8 AM to noon there will be coffee and tea provided in the hall thanks to the Companions of the Rose and the Barony of Myrgan Wood. There will also be tea and coffee at Curia on Sunday. Want something fancier? “Bean There” is open 6 AM to 2 PM in the lobby 5) I want to play games! Starting at 5 PM Rachel McNeil will be orginizing games to play 6) It’s time to dance like it’s 1453, and Constantinople is falling! Colleen Ambler is organizing a dance at 6 PM. 7 ) Where do I park? The Hotel has a large parking lot that is free of charge 8 ) I have heard tell of the Wheel of Pain where can I find it? Only Mitchell Craig (Conan of Myrgan wood) knows the true nature and location of the Wheel of Pain. Seek him out for more details. 9 ) I am having so much fun in the hall and don’t want to leave, but I need food! Where can I get it? During the day or night you can have room service brought to the hall! 10 ) I need a snack There is a convenience store by the front desk with basic snacks and toiletries. There will be a variety of snacks served around 5:30 at the bar as well. 11 ) I want to swim! The pool is open 7 AM to 10 PM enjoy a dip! 12 ) I want to help but I don’t know how! Please feel free to find a member of the event team and we can direct you to where we need people. 13) When can I setup? The hall will be open from 5 PM to 9 PM Friday night for setup. You can access the hall at 7 AM Saturday, but seriously sleep in a little, it’s the weekend. 14 ) I need a drink, where can one find something to quench my endless thirst? Water is available all day. The bar will open at 5:30 Saturday (after Squires) Last call is 12:30 AM 15 ) It’s Friday Night where are the Vigils happening? Both Vigils will be at the Saskatoon Inn. Rooms will be posted once check in begins. 16 ) When can I check into my room? Check in is at 3 PM check out is 11 AM 17 ) Can I light candles in the halls?…..? No really can I? You can’t… No not even that one… Just No. 18 ) I need to know about…. Ask a member of your event team and we will do what we can! See you all this weekend! YIS Skald, Signe, Tofa, Robert ↗︎ Event Schedule ↗︎ Pre-Registration ↗︎ Event Facebook Page
